title: Mount Shasta portal opening and the 10-foot being
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Mount Shasta portal opening and the 10-foot being, about 2014-2015 at Mount Shasta, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in 2014 they opened one 2015 I interviewed almost everybody that was in the portal. What did you see? He was this 10- foot tall guy and he had boots on.

plain: Grant Cameron, a researcher who writes about UFOs, tells a story set on Mount Shasta, a mountain in northern California, around 2014 and 2015. He says a group of people opened a "portal" there in 2014, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, and that in 2015 he interviewed almost everyone who was present. According to Cameron, what they described seeing was a being about ten feet tall who wore boots. If true, it would mean people met a giant non-human being on a California mountain.
